_note: The view of the mountains (2026-11-15, branch arashiyama-vista; VistaRules, VistaMountain, Main3D). The play camera looks 16 degrees down at the top of the frame, so no mountain ever shows from it: a few viewpoints turn the camera toward the mountains and tilt it up while the farmer stands in them, and ease it back as he leaves. `mountains`: the land rising past the maps, in plan cells (data/world.json, the village at [0, 0]), built on the maps in `maps` (each in its own cells, moved by its place on the plan). Each is a `ridge` of [x, z, height] points (world units, a cell is 1): the ground at a point is the ridge's height at the nearest point of the line less `slope` x the distance to it, with `lumps` (a value noise `lump_scale` cells across) on top, and it eases down to nothing within `foot` cells of any map on the plan (`foot` [start, full]), so it never stands on a cell anyone walks; `sink` keeps its foot below the land past the edges. `area` [x0, z0, x1, z1] bounds the mesh, `step` cells between its points. Arashiyama: the forested mountain south and south-west across the river from the long bridge, as on the real map, wrapping round the gorge's mouth to the west and on behind Minamino (Iwatayama). `colors` by season: `dark` and `light` the forest's two tones, `accent` the patches among them (spring's wild cherry, fall's maples) on `accent_share` (0..1) of the slope, `snow` on what lies above `snow_line` (a share of the highest peak, 1 for none). `ambient` the share of light in shade; `haze` [near, far, most]: the sky's colour laid over it by its distance from the eye. `views`: on map `map`, the cells `rect` [x, y, w, h]: the camera turns to `yaw` (degrees; the play camera's is 45, the eye south-east of the farmer), looks down `pitch` (degrees, less than the play camera's 30), through `fov` (vertical degrees), `dist` units back from the target, which sits `lift` units over the farmer's feet; it eases in and out over `ease` seconds. Balance numbers are ours.
